consulting_approach.detail: A short discovery conversation to clarify the decision or research question, the data available and the constraints.
A written scope covering methods, deliverables, timeline and what we need from you, agreed before work starts.
Checks for completeness, quality and suitability. We flag gaps early instead of forcing a method onto unsuitable data.
Methods chosen for the question, with assumptions checked and documented, and code that can be re-run.
A report and walkthrough in plain language, covering the limitations, with reproducible scripts where agreed.

faq.q: What kind of consulting work do you take on?
faq.a: Quantitative problems in statistics, mathematics and data science: statistical analysis and interpretation, regression and predictive modelling, forecasting, survey and experimental design, multivariate and survival analysis, quality control, optimisation and machine learning. Each service page describes the scope, what we need from you and the deliverables.

faq.q: Are the certificate courses accredited or part of a degree?
faq.a: Courses lead to a certificate of completion issued by SGT Consulting Services, the consulting and training service of SGT University. They are short professional courses, not SGT University degrees or diplomas, and they are not accredited by a government body or industry certifier. If a course gains such recognition, its course page will say so explicitly.

faq.q: Are courses open for enrolment now?
faq.a: Courses are currently listed as proposed offerings. You can register your interest through the course enquiry form, and we will contact you with confirmed dates, delivery mode and fees once a cohort is scheduled.

faq.q: How much do consulting projects and courses cost?
faq.a: Consulting is quoted per project after a scoping conversation, because the effort depends on the question, the data and the deliverables. Course fees have not been published yet; they will be shared with confirmed course details.

faq.q: Can you help with my thesis or dissertation?
faq.a: We can help you plan your methodology, choose and check appropriate statistical methods, review your analysis and explain results, so that you understand and own the work. We do not write theses, assignments or other assessed work on a student's behalf.

faq.q: What do I need to provide for a consulting project?
faq.a: A description of the question or decision, the data (or a sample and a data dictionary), any constraints such as deadlines or required software, and who will use the results. Each service page lists the specific inputs.

Data is used only for the agreed project. We can work with anonymised or de-identified data and sign a confidentiality agreement before you share anything. Enquiry details submitted through this website are stored securely and used only to respond to you.

It depends on the work and your environment. The methods we cover are taught and applied with tools such as R, Python, Excel, SQL, SPSS, MATLAB and, for big data, Hadoop, Hive, Pig and Spark. We can deliver code in the language your team uses.

faq.q: Can training be customised for our organisation?
faq.a: Yes. Workshops can be adapted in length, depth and examples, and can use your own anonymised data. Use the corporate training form to request a proposal.

No. We commit to sound methods, transparent reporting and clear explanation of limitations. We do not guarantee particular findings, model accuracy, business outcomes or publication acceptance, because those depend on the data and the question.
